english.title: Keeper of animals fail to record information re: holding register (Wales)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a keeper of animals of the ovine or caprine species, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..), failed, when

(A)_[an animal was moved onto its]_
(B)_[animals were moved onto their]_
(C)_[an animal was moved from its]_
(D)_[animals were moved from their]_

holding at **(..SPECIFY HOLDING LOCATION..), to record the information required by Section B of the Annex to Council Regulation (EC) No21/2004 and the number of animals moved in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 23(2) of the Sheep and Goats (Records, Identification and Movement) (Wales) Order 2015 and sections 73 and 75 Animal Health Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The information required to be recorded is contained in Section B of the Annex to Council Regulation (EC) No 21/2004.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
